scope: Read-only endpoint residuals at fixed western camera-column records; no fusion/map edits/reference/route calls
projection: Exact pipeline.py lidar_samples: source row/col pattern, pixel+0.5, positive mm depth, OpenGL camera-to-phone, Float32 phone points; supplied R/t in Float64 as occthres.py. Raw column binning before OctoMap fusion.
limitations: Raw endpoints are not native occupied/free probabilities; supplied split artifact does not contain per-voxel post-threshold states.
Near<=2m uses the original Float32 phone point and original camera position; it is a range diagnostic, not reproduction of the native Float32 fusion cutoff/status.
Low residuals do not distinguish real small objects from floor/depth/registration variation without independent geometry.
Camera centre passing a column is not a swept-body clearance proof.
No rejected endpoint was removed or relabelled as safe.
